title: Adjunct Instructor - General Business - John Chambers College of Business and Economics
description:
The Department of General Business at West Virginia University (
https://business.wvu.edu/academics/general-business
) invites applications for part-time adjunct positions. Potential
areas of need include undergraduate and graduate courses in
business ethics, hospital and tourism, real estate, business
communication, and more.

The successful candidate will be responsible for in-person and/or
online courses for the undergraduate programs in the Chambers
College of Business and Economics.

Applications will be accepted throughout the year and will be
considered as openings arise. Salary is established on a per-course
basis.

Qualifications :

Master's degree in a relevant field; a bachelor's degree in a
relevant field plus at least five (5) years of full-time, relevant
professional experience in the course content area may be
considered.

Please submit via PDF file (a) a letter of application summarizing
your teaching qualifications, (b) your curriculum vitae, including
professional certifications and professional experience, and (c)
contact information for two individuals who can provide letters of
recommendation.

West Virginia University is a place of purpose and community. We

From the groundbreaking R1 research at our flagship campus in

At WVU, you will discover a supportive community that champions

Join us at West Virginia University, where your work will make a
